title: Among users who obtained the 'Student' badge and have reputation equal to t
question: Among users who obtained the 'Student' badge and have reputation equal to the lowest reputation in the system, find the one whose posts received the highest total view count. Return their display name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_033"
WHERE T2."XCL_003" = 'Student'
  AND T1."XCL_053" = (SELECT MIN("XCL_053") FROM users)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052", T1."XCL_055"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_030") DESC
LIMIT 1
